briefing.summary: Approach has asked you to hold short of Canberra due to a runway inspection. Instructions just issued.

lastTransmission.speaker: atc
lastTransmission.text: Mike X-ray Golf, hold at SMOKO on the inbound track three five zero, right turns, maintain flight level one one zero, expect further clearance at zero five.

challenge.expectedText: Hold at SMOKO inbound three five zero, right turns, maintain flight level one one zero, expect further clearance at zero five, Mike X-ray Golf.

elements.label: Turn direction
elements.hint: Non-standard turn direction MUST be read back.

elements.label: Level
accept: maintain flight level one one zero

elements.label: Expect further clearance time
accept: expect further clearance at zero five
elements.hint: EFC time is mandatory — it's your lost-comms timer.

challenge.explanation: AIP ENR 1.5: full holding instruction readback is fix, inbound track, turn direction (non-standard), level, and EFC time. EFC is critical for lost-comms procedures.
